name: non-degenerate parametric oscillator (Josephson parametric converter above threshold)

provenance.source: Bergeal, N., Schackert, F., Metcalfe, M., Vijay, R., Manucharyan, V. E., Frunzio, L., Prober, D. E., Schoelkopf, R. J., Girvin, S. M., Devoret, M. H., 'Phase-preserving amplification near the quantum limit with a Josephson ring modulator', Nature 465, 64 (2010), arXiv:0912.3407 (main text; DOI 10.1038/nature09035, volume and page checked against Crossref); Roy, A., Devoret, M., 'Introduction to quantum-limited parametric amplification of quantum signals with Josephson circuits', C. R. Physique 17, 740 (2016), arXiv:1605.00539 (full text, Secs. 4-5)
provenance.kind: classical image of census entry 26: Josephson parametric converter (JPC) on a Josephson ring modulator: phase-preserving amplifier

symmetric-write.obstruction: degenerate critical mode: 2 directions become critical together at the write point; the critical eigenspace is 2-dimensional, so the drift reduced to one critical line, a pitchfork of one component, does not describe the write

threshold-write.obstruction: a single stable state: there is no second state to switch to
threshold-write.obstruction_short: a single stable state: nothing to switch to

phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of Ein in [0, 3] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: degenerate critical mode: 2 directions become critical together; the critical eigenspace is 2-dimensional, not a line

law.status: continuous family of written states (a marginal direction at every one): the write sets a phase on the family, not a choice between states; its law is that of a phase (Adler)
